_comment: Scenario and condition definitions for src/simulation.py. All values are SIMULATION ASSUMPTIONS, documented in SYNTHETIC_DATA_METHODOLOGY.md. Units: kcal/day for energy, kg for weight, days for time. Ranges [a, b] are sampled uniformly per simulated user.

seeds._comment: Development seeds are used for every design decision (method choice, window, interval method, thresholds). Evaluation seeds are used once, for the reported results. The two ranges never overlap.

stable.description: Energy balance planned at zero for the whole period.

deficit_to_maintenance.description: Planned deficit that stops abruptly (diet ends) at a random day.

deficit_to_surplus.description: Planned deficit followed by a surplus (rebound) from a random day.

gradual_drift.description: Planned balance moves linearly from a deficit to roughly maintenance over the period (slowly fading adherence).

conditions._comment: Observation conditions. noise_scale multiplies the water-weight and scale-error standard deviations. missing_rate is the fraction of days with no reading. outlier_rate is the per-reading probability of a gross error.

mechanism_A._comment: Ledger model: tissue weight changes by (energy balance / kcal_per_kg) each day. This shares the estimator's conversion assumption on purpose.

mechanism_B._comment: Two-compartment model with adaptive expenditure. Scenario kcal values are PLANNED INTAKE offsets from initial maintenance; the realised energy balance then evolves as expenditure responds. This model deliberately does NOT share the estimator's 7700 kcal/kg assumption.
